review.method: Fixed real-photo ROI and authored transformations before inference; no human physical review
review.scope: 120 transformed frames from one photo; six scenarios, not 120 independent trials

positiveDetectorOverlap.scope: same-family IoU >= 0.35 at positive target frames, not detector recall on exhaustively labelled scenes

limits: allSceneFalseNotices applies only to the 80 known-negative frames. Positive controls affect a local image envelope, potentially changing unreviewed neighbours; unmatched reports there are not certified true or false. Percentiles are not pooled or added. See source score artifacts for individual timings, unknowns and provenance. No physical metres, phone speed or navigation safety has been established.
